architecture.memory: Memory Graph v12 with explicit domain/context identity; an exact Main-bound Task may be projected mechanically without Memory search/ranking.
architecture.runtime: Physical truth/execution invariants, persistence, exact Active Task projection, surface materialization, Memory/Evidence/Material reachability, per-call context safety, provider-reported per-message token budget and transactions; no semantic routing.
architecture.adapter: Simple DeepSeek connection boundary: fixed configured model, request/response transport, one caller-supplied JSON Schema contract delivered once to the provider, mechanical JSON recovery, schema validation, one isolated format-only repair, usage/transport telemetry; no Eyle semantics or execution policy.

contracts.wire: Rev4 uses three Eyle-owned structured protocol surfaces: navigation chooses one of the existing ECC movements; explore exposes only observe/execute operations; build exposes only mutate operations. Adapter remains generic and receives exactly the current caller-supplied surface schema.
contracts.memory: Memory remains current-by-default semantic knowledge with preserved revision history. Task Memory reuses ordinary mem-* nodes/relations. Semantic supports are revision-pinned when created; source revision drift is exposed mechanically, never interpreted as falsity.
contracts.recall: FTS5/SQL candidate discovery is literal/mechanical. scope=all reaches user + current world; scope=global reaches all current nodes across every world. Exact physical domain/context_key filters are supported. Activated bodies are materialized once through memory_view; operation observations stay compact. Main judges semantic relevance.
contracts.frontier: Frontier is an exact continuation after the current materialized page. Live-source Frontiers are revision-bound; source drift is reported mechanically and makes the Frontier stale without semantic invalidation of historical Evidence.
contracts.adapter: Adapter owns connection/auth, fixed DeepSeek request translation, delivery of Eyle's caller-supplied JSON Schema as the single provider-facing representation contract, mechanical JSON recovery, validation, exactly one isolated format-only repair and transport/usage facts. Repair reuses only schema + prior candidate + validation errors, never the full Eyle context.
contracts.execution: Eyle owns deterministic execution progress and durable logical continuity. Rev4 checkpoints preserve active_task_id and cognitive_surface in addition to the existing canonical session/runtime state. Cognitive surface is protocol state, never semantic intent.
contracts.source: workspace and eyle are physical source identities, never inferred semantically.
contracts.interaction: Main participates directly rather than defaulting to help-desk offers/menus. Main authors semantic choices; Runtime owns physical confirmations. Only physical confirmation authorizes an exact prepared mutation.
contracts.sandbox_promotion: A tested sandbox file/subtree can be frozen as a hash-bound durable staging artifact and promoted to the real workspace with one exact confirmation; merge does not delete unrelated target files and mirror is explicit.
contracts.context_hygiene: Deterministic ContextMaterializer pages conversation, observations, runtime feedback and explicit Memory activations by physical token budget. No fixed semantic item ceiling or automatic Memory projection is part of the runtime.
contracts.task_memory: A task is an ordinary kind=task Memory node. Runtime maintains only active/blocked/resolved/cancelled lifecycle state and state revisions; task relations and semantic content remain Main-authored. Task Memory never creates a recall boundary.
contracts.provenance: Memory/relation support freezes the exact referenced source revision. Revision history exposes changeset execution/turn and revision-specific anchors. A later source revision is reported as source_revised, not semantically invalidated.
contracts.optimization: Optimization remains monotonic: compact presentation may reduce prompt cost, but no physical Material, Evidence, Frontier, or Memory becomes unreachable to Main.
contracts.investigation_quality: Structural inventory is orientation, not sufficient evidence for behavioral/architectural analysis. Main is instructed to inspect representative implementation before concluding material claims.
contracts.conversation: Recent conversation is transported with native user/assistant roles; the active current_request is emitted exactly once as the final provider user message. Materialization is physical-token-budgeted and omitted history remains reachable.
contracts.self_identity: Eyle is the running agent. Main interprets unqualified self references against the running Eyle instance; source=eyle is self source and source=workspace is the user's selected project. Runtime does not semantically route these references.
contracts.task_surface: Tasks remain Memory Graph kind=task/domain=task. Main alone binds active_task_id; Runtime validates and projects that exact ID without recall/ranking. Persisted state may be complete while each cognitive surface is purpose-bounded.

publication.compatibility: Current-schema only: Session/config 2.7.5-r4.0.0-ecc, execution-continuity-v6, pending 16-ecc. Rev3.7.8 is the historical base, not an accepted current wire/session schema.

release_notes.reality_binding: Live read_file/search_code continuations are bound to exact source revisions and reject source drift as FRONTIER_SOURCE_REVISED before materializing new bytes.
release_notes.checkpoint_identity: recoverable_execution storage is singular per execution_id with atomic replacement and monotonic checkpoint_generation.
release_notes.provider_identity: Persisted continuations bind to stable Host-owned provider_identity_hash rather than mutable provider execution context.
release_notes.coverage: Mechanical file coverage is source-revision aware and never merges ranges from different file revisions.
release_notes.provenance: Historical Evidence/Materials remain intact when a live source changes; Runtime reports physical drift without semantic invalidation.
